_bz_lag_s: seconds from an article's published time to the time it counts as known; initial value, to be replaced by the measured live delay (our receipt time minus published) before the final training; read by l1bz.News
_bz_n60_s: length of the window of bz_n60 in seconds (60 minutes); read by l1bz.News
_bz_n1d_s: length of the window of bz_n1d, of bz_rk's numerator and of the four channel flags, in seconds (24 hours); read by l1bz.News
_bz_n3d_s: length of the window of bz_n3d in seconds (72 hours); read by l1bz.News
_bz_hist_days: prior trading days of the look-back of bz_min, bz_solo and of the mean in bz_rk; read by l1bz.News
_bz_rk_floor: floor of the mean daily article count in bz_rk, articles a day (0.05 = one article in 20 trading days), so that a stock with no article in the window and one today has its own value; read by l1bz.News
_bz_channels: the four channel sets of the flags bz_c_earn, bz_c_anl, bz_c_deal, bz_c_mov, exact Benzinga channel names in lower case (spec ruling b9cf732e); read by l1bz.News
_er_surp_floor: floor of |estimated EPS| in the denominator of er_surp, dollars a share (one cent); read by l1bz.Earnings
_er_gap_reports: number of the ticker's last reports whose gaps give the median in er_next, reports; read by l1bz.Earnings
_er_min_reports: fewest past reports for er_next (fewer = missing), reports; read by l1bz.Earnings
_fl_lag_days: calendar days from a 10-K's filing date to the day its float fact counts as known; read by l1fl.facts
_fl_forms: SEC forms whose EntityPublicFloat fact is an annual fact of the fl group (annual report, its amendment, transition report; each known from its own filing date); read by l1fl.facts
